description: Prepare an email as a draft without sending it. Call this when you want to stage a message for later or for a human to review before it goes out — send it afterward with send_draft. Same fields as send_email, or omit to/subject and pass reply_to_message_id to draft a threaded reply. Returns the draft id with status "draft".

mailbox_id.description: Id of the mailbox the draft belongs to, from list_mailboxes.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional. Draft a threaded reply to this message; recipient and subject are derived from it. Cannot be changed later with update_draft.

subject.description: Subject line. Omit only when passing reply_to_message_id, which supplies it.

to.description: Recipient address. Omit only when passing reply_to_message_id, which supplies it.

name: create_draft
